definitions.recall: All required source memories must occur in top 5; denominator is positive cases only.
definitions.top1: First retrieved source must be one of the independently expected sources.
definitions.answer: Closed answer groups plus persisted source references; unknown questions require explicit uncertainty.
definitions.hallucination_proxy: Unknown/unsupported questions answered without explicit uncertainty; conservative Mock proxy, not LLM semantic grading.
definitions.resources: Python allocation peak is incremental evaluation allocation. RSS/peak RSS covers process lifetime, including preparation.
definitions.live: This batch performs no real DeepSeek calls. Earlier live samples are separate evidence.
